route: MCP document commands -> terminal Catallax field stage -> certified labelled STL
supported_limits: One terminal cubic lattice in the part frame; S1 uses cell size 5 mm, radius 1 to 1.5 mm, accuracy 0.1 mm, minimum detail 0.5 mm and the default caps. Drawings remain deferred; graded radii and field mass are in the graded-fields scenario. Each export is one whole request within the application limit, with fixed output hashes; a zero allowance or one above the limit refuses and leaves the destination unchanged.
